name: Cosmos Internet Services
summary: Melbourne low-cost dialup then hosting/data-centre provider; acquired by Mikka International 2001, still operating under Cosmos name.

events.details: Acquired by Mikka International (2001), still trading as Cosmos Internet Services (cosmos.net.au: 'Mikka International (trading as) Cosmos Internet Services', ABN 97 075 155 225). Prior 'death c.2005' record was fabricated boilerplate and has been removed.
